newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Yieh Loong units fall on SEC investigation.
newsitem.headline: Yieh Loong units fall on SEC investigation.

text.p: Share prices for three listed subsidiaries of Taiwan's Yieh Loong Steel group plunged in late trade on Tuesday on news the group is being investigated by the Securities and Exchange Commission, brokers said.

With 55 minutes left, Yieh Loong Co and Yieh Hsing Enterprise Co Ltd had dropped the daily seven-percent limit, or T$1.30 and T$1.20 respectively, to T$17.80 and T$16.90. Yieh Phui was down 4.56 percent or T$1.30 to T$27.20.
A spokeswoman for the Commission said prosecutors were investigating counterfeit invoices alleged to have been used by 40 firms to carry out financial fraud.
She said the three listed subsidiaries of the Yieh Loong steel group were among the 40 firms.

Two Yieh Loong Steel group spokesmen have directly denied any wrongdoing. "We strongly denied any charges saying our group was involved in the scandal," Yieh Phui vice-president Chang Shui-wang told Reuters by telephone.
